verdict.rationale: Scoping credentials for an agent is a fair question for an agent product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for a Bot. What it documents are adjacent controls: per-action approvals (Allow once / Always allow / Deny), Auto Review rules, local-execution approval and network egress controls. The runtime probe also found no public Grok Bot API surface at all, so these approval and network features do not count as credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
